thread:
jake.s: Quick handoff — ZephyrPilot (P-2000) signed POC, moving to CS for onboarding. Trial on Dedicated, wants private/VPC eval. Trial credits end in 10 days. Primary asks: Okta SSO, consistent sub-1s tail latency for chat, and audit logs. Open ENG ticket blocking SSO: #ENG-1234. Account: ZP-983, region us-west2, expected peak ~40 qps. @maria.cs can you pick up enablement + takeover?

maria.cs: Taking this. Thanks Jake. Can you confirm SSO contact at customer and whether they already shared IdP metadata? Also - any priority for which features we demo first?

jake.s: Yep — contact is emily@zephyr.ai. They uploaded metadata to our portal but reported an error during assertion. Demo priority: chat + embedding search. They care most about latency under load.

sophie.ops: I'll start provisioning checklist: 1) confirm VPC peering request, 2) allocate dedicated pool (GPU type: A10G preferred), 3) create onboarding workspace + sample corpus. Any compliance tags?

maria.cs: Compliance: HIPAA-ish data (PHI-like), customer asked for encrypted-at-rest + KMS. Tag as "private-deploy-consider". Sophie pls also request extended retention for audit logs.

liam.eng: I looked at ENG-1234. The assertion error is an audience mismatch in SAML response. Need the exact SP EntityID they used. Jake, can you ask Emily to paste the raw SAML response (or give us IdP metadata URL)? For latency: we've seen tokenization and KV-cache pressure at longer contexts causing 1.5-2.5s tails — possible mitigation: enable prefix KV cache and reduce batch size for interactive routes. Quick workaround: route to a slightly smaller variant (redwood-llama-13b-q2) during peak.

priya.se: Priya here — I can run a quick config template for them. Sharing minimal config snippet to attach to the onboarding ticket so CS can use it during the enablement call:

```
region: us-west2
deployment:
  type: dedicated
  gpu: a10g
  batch_size: 4
  kv_cache: enabled
network:
  vpc_peering: requested
  sso: saml
  sso_entity_id: https://app.redwood.ai/sp
kms: customer-kms
```

priya.se: I'll also prepare a 30m enablement deck focused on chat latencies and fallback model policy.

liam.eng: For ENG ticket next steps: 1) Jake to paste SAML response or IdP metadata (by EOD). 2) If we can't fix SAML, workaround is temporary API key for onboarding (logged & rotated) — need approval from security. 3) I'll add a canary routing rule to fallback to 13b for interactive route until KV-cache tuning lands.

jake.s: Emily said she'll paste the raw SAML tonight. Security gave green light for temporary API key for trial with strict logging.

sophie.ops: Created onboarding ticket CS-7721 and linked ENG-1234. Provision request submitted to infra (PR-5566). Assigned owners: maria.cs (owner), sophie.ops (ops lead), liam.eng (eng triage), priya.se (enablement).

maria.cs: Scheduling enablement call — propose Tue 10am PT. I’ll send calendar invite and enablement checklist. Sophie pls include prerequisites (IdP reply, sample dataset, contact details).

jake.s: ✅ Emily confirmed Tue 10am PT works. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: provisioning-task PR-5566 -> started (job id 89012).

maria.cs: Actionable next steps for CS handoff note: 1) Run enablement deck Tue 10am, 2) verify SAML assertion with ENG before call, 3) provide onboarding workspace + sample corpus before call, 4) confirm KMS integration plan and escalate if blocked. I'll update CS-7721 with owners and close the loop post-call.

liam.eng: I'll monitor latency metrics during trial and post a quick dashboard link in CS-7721. If we see >1s 95th percentile, we'll enable the 13b fallback and notify CS.

priya.se: I'll capture customer feedback in the onboarding notes doc and add a short evaL prompt set to watch for quality regressions.

jake.s: Thanks team — handing off now. Ping here if anything blocks before Tue.
